_doc: Fixed answer rubric. score.py computes the deterministic signals; every answer row stays needs-judge until a judge records a verdict per criterion. No model judge is built in.
normalize: lower case, collapse whitespace, straight quotes; facts match as substrings

criteria.fact: Every expected fact is stated as the answer (not merely mentioned as a rejected option).
criteria.citation: The answer names the day of at least one relevant entry (e.g. 'January 21', '21 January' or '2030-01-21').
criteria.stale: No forbidden fact (a distractor, a superseded value or a deleted detail) is asserted as true.
criteria.abstention: For expect_abstain rows: the answer says the diary does not record it and invents nothing.
criteria.false_abstention: For answerable rows: an abstention is a failure.
criteria.ambiguity: For ambiguous rows: the answer names both candidates or asks which one is meant.
criteria.confirmed_vs_inferred: The answer separates what the diary records from what it infers.
